Sub-Microsecond State, Memory, and Verifiable Logs

How tamper-evident logs, dual-time indexes, and zero-copy memory maps turn expensive recomputation into sub-microsecond reads.

[0.325 Microsecond Lookup · 1.77 Microjoules · 0 Drift]

1/3 Conventional software burns needless time and electricity unpacking text and recalculating answers it already solved.

2/3 Immutable fingerprint-chained logs and bitemporal indexes let any machine replay exact past states without guesswork.

3/3 Zero-copy memory-mapped lookup stores turn repeated work into sub-microsecond reads costing under two microjoules.
